## **CLEANING SERVICES AGREEMENT**

### 1. PARTIES

**1.1** This service agreement is entered into between **BrightSpan Cleaning Services CC (sample)**, registration number 2011/000000/23 ("the Contractor"), and **Marula Office Supplies (Pty) Ltd** ("the Client").

### 2. DEFINITIONS

**2.1** "**Premises**" means the Client's offices at Unit 4, Oakridge Business Park, 12 Sample Road, Sampleton;

**2.2** "**Services**" means the cleaning services described in Schedule 1 and the cleaning checklist in Schedule 2;

**2.3** "**Service Hours**" means the hours stated in Schedule 1, or such other hours as the parties agree in writing;

**2.4** "**Site Supervisor**" means the Contractor's employee responsible for supervising its staff at the Premises;

**2.5** "**Monthly Fee**" means the fee stated in Schedule 1, excluding any extra services ordered in writing.

### 3. DURATION

**3.1** Services commence on 1 April 2026 for an initial period of 6 (six) months.

**3.2** After the initial period, this agreement continues on a month-to-month basis.

### 4. SCOPE

**4.1** The Contractor shall perform the Services at the Premises during the Service Hours, using its own staff, equipment and cleaning materials, except the consumables referred to in clause 10.4.

**4.2** The Client may request extra services, such as deep cleaning or carpet shampooing, which shall be quoted and invoiced separately.

# 5. SERVICE STANDARDS

**5.1** The Contractor shall perform the Services with due care and skill and to the standard reflected in the checklist in Schedule 2.

**5.2** The Site Supervisor shall inspect the Premises at least once a week and complete the inspection sheet, a copy of which shall be available to the Client on request.

**5.3** The Client shall report any complaint about the Services to the Site Supervisor in writing. The Contractor shall remedy a valid complaint by the end of the next working day.

# 6. STAFF

**6.1** The Contractor is responsible for its staff, equipment and materials.

**6.2** The Contractor shall ensure that each staff member placed at the Premises has been screened, including a criminal record check, and shall provide proof of screening on request.

**6.3** Staff shall wear the Contractor's uniform and identification at all times while on the Premises.

**6.4** The Contractor's staff are not employees of the Client. The Contractor is solely responsible for their wages, benefits and statutory deductions and for compliance with applicable sectoral determinations.

# 7. HEALTH AND SAFETY

**7.1** The Contractor shall comply with the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 and shall remain registered in good standing under the Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act 130 of 1993.

**7.2** Cleaning chemicals shall be stored and labelled correctly, and safety data sheets shall be kept at the Premises.

# 8. KEYS, ALARM CODES AND SECURITY

**8.1** The Client shall issue the Contractor with keys and an alarm code for the Premises. The Contractor shall keep them secure, record their use and report any loss immediately.

**8.2** The Contractor is liable for the cost of replacing locks and keys lost through its negligence.

## **9. TERMINATION**

**9.1** Either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' written notice.

**9.2** Either party may terminate immediately on material breach by the other.

**9.3** On termination the Contractor shall return all keys, remote controls and access cards, and remove its equipment, within 2 (two) days.

## **10. FEES AND PAYMENT**

**10.1** The Client shall pay the Monthly Fee monthly in arrears, within 30 (thirty) days of the date of the Contractor's tax invoice.

**10.2** Extra services shall be invoiced at the rates quoted and accepted in writing before the work is done.

**10.3** The Client may withhold a reasonable portion of any invoice relating to a complaint that has not been remedied in terms of clause 5.3, until it is remedied.

**10.4** The Client shall supply toilet paper, hand soap and paper towels. The Contractor shall notify the Client when stock falls below one week's supply.

## **11. LIABILITY AND INSURANCE**

**11.1** The Contractor shall be liable for loss of or damage to the Client's property caused by the negligence or dishonesty of its staff.

**11.2** The Contractor shall maintain public liability insurance of not less than R5 000 000.00 per event and shall provide proof of cover on request.

## **12. NON-SOLICITATION**

**12.1** The Client shall not, during this agreement and for 6 (six) months afterwards, employ any of the Contractor's staff who worked at the Premises, without the Contractor's written consent.

## **13. PERSONAL INFORMATION**

**13.1** The Contractor's staff may have incidental access to personal information at the Premises. The Contractor shall ensure they keep it confidential and do not remove, copy or disclose any document or data.

**13.2** The Client may keep access logs and CCTV footage of the Contractor's staff entering the Premises for security purposes, in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013.

## **14. DISPUTES**

**14.1** The parties shall try to resolve any dispute by meeting within 10 (ten) days of either party's written request. Failing resolution, either party may approach a court with jurisdiction.

## **15. DOMICILIUM**

**15.1** The parties choose their addresses in the heading of this agreement as their domicilia citandi et executandi.

## **16. GENERAL**

**16.1** This agreement, with its schedules, is the whole agreement between the parties. No variation is valid unless in writing and signed by both parties.

**16.2** Neither party may cede its rights without the other's written consent.

**SIGNED AT SAMPLETON**

# **SCHEDULE 1 · SERVICE DETAILS**

**1** Monthly fee: R6 900.00.
**2** Scope: daily office cleaning, Monday to Friday.
**3** Hours: 17:00 to 19:00.
**4** Notice of termination: one calendar month's notice.
**5** Staff complement: 2 (two) cleaners daily; Site Supervisor weekly inspection.
**6** Windows: interior glass cleaned monthly; exterior glass excluded.

# **SCHEDULE 2 · CLEANING CHECKLIST**

| Area      | Task                                                         | Frequency |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | --------- |
| Offices   | Empty bins, dust desks and surfaces, vacuum carpets          | Daily     |
| Kitchen   | Wash dishes, wipe counters, clean fridge exterior, mop floor | Daily     |
| Toilets   | Clean and sanitise, refill consumables, mop floor            | Daily     |
| Reception | Clean glass doors, polish counter, mop floor                 | Daily     |
| Kitchen   | Clean fridge interior and microwave                          | Weekly    |
| All areas | Dust skirtings, light switches and door frames               | Weekly    |
| All areas | Interior windows and blinds                                  | Monthly   |
